title: 最长升降交替段长度
description: 输出数组中相邻元素大小关系严格交替（升、降、升、降…）的最长一段的长度。
inputFormat: 第一行一个整数 $n$（$1 \le n \le 1000$）；第二行 $n$ 个整数 $a_i$，用空格隔开。

solutions.python:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(data[0])
a = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
best = 1
cur = 1
prev = 0
for i in range(1, n):
    if a[i] > a[i - 1]:
        sign = 1
    elif a[i] < a[i - 1]:
        sign = -1
    else:
        sign = 0
    if sign != 0 and prev != 0 and sign != prev:
        cur += 1
    else:
        cur = 1 if sign == 0 else 2
    prev = sign
    best = max(best, cur)
print(best)
